changelog.summary: Combines engineering data foundation, delivery/quality/reliability intelligence, and recurring operations review into one small-team workflow playbook.

title: Engineering Operations Intelligence
description: Connect engineering data, calculate governed delivery, quality, and reliability intelligence, and run evidence-backed reviews in one small-team workflow.
setup_prompt: Use Engineering Operations Intelligence for my small engineering team. Build one workflow that connects only authorized sources, preserves provenance and customer metric definitions, calculates reproducible delivery, quality, and reliability signals, produces a recurring evidence-backed review, and tracks approved actions and outcomes.

setup_inputs.label: Team, repositories, services, environments, and authorized engineering sources
History, freshness, timezone, identity, and workflow-state mappings
Engineering goals, metric definitions, targets, exclusions, and data-quality minimums
Review audience, cadence, comparison window, and required sections
Action owners, approval policy, delivery destinations, and notification conditions
Retention, restricted fields, access policy, and source-of-truth precedence

recommended_tools.name: GitHub or GitLab MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Read authorized repositories, pull requests, reviews, commits, and checks

recommended_tools.name: Issue-tracker MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Read work items and create explicitly approved follow-up work

recommended_tools.name: CI and deployment MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Read build, deployment, rollback, and release events

recommended_tools.name: Observability and incident MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Read incidents, alerts, service identity, and recovery evidence

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks workflow database
recommended_tools.purpose: Persist normalized records, metric snapshots, findings, reviews, decisions, actions, and receipts

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks schedules and triggers
recommended_tools.purpose: Refresh sources and run a proven review route at the approved cadence

pulse_focus.label: Strategic review
focus_areas: Whether the intelligence supports the team's important engineering decisions
Actionability, unintended incentives, operating cost, and measured outcomes
review_when: Outcomes regress, priorities change, or recurring reviews stop producing useful actions

outputs: Normalized source-linked engineering records and freshness status
Versioned delivery, quality, and reliability metric snapshots
Recurring engineering operations review and dashboard
Durable decisions, tracked actions, outcomes, and delivery receipts
